summary: Stores two consecutive dwords into a physics/vehicle state object: a2 at a3 + 5084 and result at a3 + 5088, then returns result (eax). The __userpurge ABI reuses the eax return register as the second stored value; a4 is unused.

operations.description: Store the first int a2 (edx) into the state object: *(_DWORD *)(a3 + 5084) = a2.
Store the second int result (eax) into the adjacent state slot: *(_DWORD *)(a3 + 5088) = result.
Return result (eax), which is also the value just stored at a3 + 5088.
__userpurge ABI: result arrives in eax, a2 in edx, a3 (state base) in ecx; a4 is declared but unused.
